Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
Many thanks. Our letters have crossed but the enclosure was welcome in any way of having it.[^1]
I hope to finish [Abraham](/topic/177) today and send it

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: A [cheque](/topic/160) for £200.
